descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S15 Tap Generate, leave the chart at once: the note still lands and the dashboard row shows it

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 Generate runs server-side. After tapping Generate, the physician can leave the chart (for example, for the dashboard), and the counts update when the note is ready, whether or not the chart is open (UAT 3.5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U4 With the dashboard open, the counts update without a page reload when a note is generated or an encounter is completed (UAT TC-20; TFA-92598 AC 3; TFA-92598 How it works 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • U8 Each Save Note and Generate run in TC-20 logs the AI call time (aiCallLog.providerMs) separately from the total (durationMs). Save Note targets 15 s or less in 9/10 runs. … (UAT 3.5)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Standard fixture; the Hospital patient is pending, the resident In Today and pending

When Type encounter text, tap Generate Note & Finish and immediately go Back to the list and open the dashboard without returning to the chart. Wait up to 60 s. Then open the chart's Post-Round tab. Repeat in Nursing Home

Then UAT 3.5: the note is generated server-side and lands. The dashboard row shows Note Ready when it is ready, without opening the chart, and the patient leaves Pending. The Post-Round tab then shows the note, or the explicit 'Note not generated' message with the dictation kept; never a blank tab or a stuck generating state

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.5. Dashboard checkpoint 60 s after leaving: mustContain 'Rounding Dashboard' and the patient; rowBadge Note Ready (Hospital's Pending 0 alone proves nothing, because the 'seen' write at the tap already moves the patient out of Pending); counts Total 1, Pending 0. Post-Round checkpoint: the generated note, or 'Note not generated' with the dictation kept. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S15 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-20.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: newspec-c.

Judged U6 5/5 per mode. Recorded: Total tile 1 (U4, TFA-92598 in progress: todo); U8 timings need the live model (dev: notes.generateNote 3–8 s in the TC-14/S07 / S26 dev runs).
